verdict: NOT READY - APP_DEBUG is enabled in the committed environment and there is no deployment documentation

findings.title: APP_DEBUG enabled
findings.evidence: php artisan about reports Debug Mode: ENABLED in the current environment.
findings.impact: In production this exposes stack traces, file paths, environment values and query SQL to any caller - and SEC-02 means some endpoints are reachable without authentication.
findings.remediation: APP_DEBUG=false and APP_ENV=production in the production environment.

findings.title: .env.testing committed with real database credentials and not git-ignored
findings.evidence: .env.testing contains db_illuvision_testing credentials in plaintext and is absent from .gitignore.
findings.remediation: Add to .gitignore, rotate the credential if it has ever been shared, and inject it in CI as a secret.

findings.title: 55 environment keys gate behaviour
findings.impact: No documented list of which keys are required in production versus optional, so a missing key silently falls back to a development default (for example LOG_CHANNEL defaulting to stack, QUEUE_CONNECTION).

findings.title: No documented rollback procedure
findings.impact: 112 migrations are applied; a failed release has no recorded reverse path.
